title: CHIP protects rheumatoid arthritis progression by targeting TRAF6 in arthritis animal models.
snippet: Carboxyl terminus of HSC70-interacting protein (CHIP) serves as a quality control protein that involves in inflammation and immunity, bone remodeling and tumorigenesis.
